user.title: Mozillion
user.description: Connect to Mozillion to fetch data usage.

manual_ids.title: Enter IDs Manually
manual_ids.description: Enter your order detail ID and SIM meta ID. Both are visible on the Mozillion dashboard's SIM selector.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Mozillion
reauth_confirm.description: Your Mozillion session has expired. Provide new credentials or a fresh cookie header.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Reconfigure Mozillion
reconfigure_confirm.description: Update the credentials or pick a different SIM to track.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check your credentials, cookie header and that the SIM is still on your account.
error.missing_auth: Provide either email+password (and optional TOTP) or a cookie header.

user.title: Add a SIM
user.description: Choose another SIM on this account to track.

manual_ids.title: Enter IDs Manually
manual_ids.description: Enter the order detail ID and SIM meta ID for the SIM. Both are visible on the Mozillion dashboard's SIM selector.

reconfigure.title: Change SIM
reconfigure.description: Pick a different SIM for this device. The device and its history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mozillion, or the SIM could not be confirmed. Check the connection and try again.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Mozillion account is not running, so a SIM cannot be added. Start the integration and try again.
abort.no_new_sims: Every SIM on this account is already tracked.

dashboard_unreadable.title: Mozillion dashboard cannot be read
